phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the stars tonight, but the mild air keeps guests on the rooftop terrace facing the lit Eiffel Tower.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud cross the sky above the Arc de Triomphe, seen from the rooftop dining table this afternoon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool is still, and the dark outline of Sugarloaf is already visible against the lightening sky.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over Copacabana this afternoon, and swimmers in the rooftop pool watch their shadows move across the beach.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, broken clouds over Sugarloaf catch warm light, best seen from the terrace loungers.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the ocean looks grey too, but the soaking tub beside the bathroom window still works perfectly.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on Copacabana today, and guests watch the grey ocean from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of their rooms.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm sits over the Atlantic, and from a waterfront balcony you could watch the lightning without getting wet.

phrases.clear_night: On a clear night, guests in the oceanfront rooms hear the surf and see the dark outline of Haystack Rock under stars.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds move across the sky over Haystack Rock this morning, so the light on the beach changes between bites of breakfast.
phrases.partly_afternoon: This afternoon, sun and cloud take turns over the open water, seen from the decks and patios of the oceanfront rooms.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun lights the sea stacks between clouds, and the verandas are the usual place to watch it.

phrases.rain: Rain falls on the beach, so guests watch the sea stacks from the covered deck or beside a room fireplace.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm is over the Pacific, and the oceanfront rooms give a dry seat for lightning above the open water.
phrases.fog_haze: Coastal fog covers most of the beach today, and from the covered deck only the nearest sea stack shows through.
phrases.snow: Snow on Cannon Beach is rare, but today the lawn outside the lodge is white and every room fireplace is in use.
phrases.very_cold: It feels close to freezing on the verandas, so guests watch Haystack Rock from behind the balcony doors with the fire lit.

phrases.mild_night: On this mild, cloudy night, the surf is audible from the room decks and the lobby cookies are still out.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the WET Deck pool is already open, and the Brisbane River sits dark below a clear sky.

phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would swim in the WET Deck pool at midnight with the Brisbane River in view.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds come and go over the river this morning, so the view from the river rooms changes every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud sit over Brisbane this afternoon, and from the suite windows the Story Bridge moves in and out of shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the hills beyond the Kurilpa Bridge are lit between the clouds, seen from the suite bar.
phrases.overcast: A flat grey sky covers Brisbane today, but the river and Story Bridge are still easy to see from most rooms.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the Brisbane River, and the pool stays open, with the wet city visible through its windows.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the river view from the King Suite includes lightning over the city, with glass between you and the weather.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze sits on the river today, and Mt. Coot-tha is missing from the far end of the view.
phrases.snow: Snow in Brisbane would be a first, but the WET Deck pool would still be open and the river still in view.
phrases.very_cold: On a rare very cold Brisbane day, the Story Bridge and the river look sharp through the suite windows.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over Brisbane, and the WET Deck pool is the obvious place to watch the river from.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild under cloud, and the pool is still open with the Brisbane River as its usual backdrop.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low today, so Mt. Coot-tha cannot be seen, and the view stops at the river and the nearer bridges.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Canton Tower stands dark across the Pearl River, seen from the floor-to-ceiling windows of every room.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: In the late afternoon, sunlight falls on the Canton Tower, and guests on the garden terrace watch it from river level.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Patches of cloud and sun alternate over the Pearl River this afternoon, and the poolside bar is open in the mixed light.
phrases.partly_golden: If you were on the rooftop terrace now, you would see the last sun lighting the Canton Tower between the clouds.
phrases.overcast: Low grey cloud sits over the Pearl River today, yet the Canton Tower stays clearly visible from the outdoor pool.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Pearl River, and guests in the soaking tub of the marble bathroom still see the Canton Tower.
phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, the pool and terraces are empty, and guests watch lightning behind the Canton Tower from their room windows.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the Pearl River softens the outline of the Canton Tower today, seen from the garden terrace at river level.

phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for Guangzhou, so the outdoor pool is quiet and the Canton Tower stands sharp in clear air.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot this afternoon, so the outdoor pool is the practical place to look at the Canton Tower across the Pearl River.
phrases.mild_night: Clouds cover the sky on this mild night, yet the LED display of the Canton Tower still reflects across the Pearl River.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop suites face a dark ocean and a protected landscape that is still only an outline.
phrases.clear_morning: Morning sun is on the rooftop suites, and from the pool water the ocean and the parkland are both in view.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun reaches the balconies of the orange villas, and the countryside around them turns a warmer colour before sunset.
phrases.clear_night: If you were there tonight, you would see stars over the protected parkland from a rooftop suite and a dark ocean beyond.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds pass over the Costa Vicentina this morning, so the rooftop plunge pools get sun for a few minutes at a time.
phrases.partly_afternoon: On the waterfront lawn this afternoon, the red Adirondack chairs sit in sun and shade by turns, facing the river.
phrases.partly_golden: Seen from a rooftop pool, the last sun lights some of the ocean while clouds keep other parts of it grey.
phrases.overcast: Under a full grey sky, the view from the balconies is a landscape of dull green trees and a colourless ocean.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the 220-hectare estate, and guests stay inside the Azeitona restaurant for a long, dry meal.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm over the ocean means the rooftop plunge pools are empty for now, and the lightning is watched from indoors.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog has moved in from the sea, and the window of the spa treatment room shows white where the water normally is.
phrases.snow: Snow is very rare on this coast, but today a little falls on the gardens around the orange villas.
phrases.very_cold: A very cold day for the Algarve, the sky is clear over the parkland, but nobody is in the rooftop plunge pools.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot air sits over the estate, and the marble plunge pools on the rooftops are the only comfortable place outside.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild night under cloud, the balconies of the villas look out at a dark landscape with no stars above it.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the moat below the Palace-facing rooms is still dark, and the swans are not yet easy to spot.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun is now on the Imperial Palace gardens, the part of the view that changes most by breakfast tomorrow.
phrases.clear_night: On the rooftop terrace tonight, the lit skyline is sharp, and the gardens below are mostly dark.
phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over the moat this morning, so the king room view changes from bright to grey every few minutes.
phrases.partly_afternoon: If you were on the green planted terrace this afternoon, you would see the skyline under broken cloud, half in sun.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the moat looks flat and the gardens look darker green, which the swans do not seem to mind.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the moat and the gardens, and guests in the fitness center watch it through the floor-to-ceiling windows.

phrases.snow: Snow is settling on the Imperial Palace gardens, a rare sight in Tokyo, and the king room windows face it directly.
phrases.very_cold: Outside it is close to freezing, and from the upper rooms the swans on the moat keep moving under a clear sky.

phrases.mild_night: Clouds sit over the skyline on this mild night, and the rooftop terrace tables are lit and in use.
phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is limited today, so from the fitness center windows the river is clear but the far skyline is not.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Century City twin towers stand as dark shapes against a clear sky above the still-empty pool deck.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late afternoon sun turns the Century City towers orange, seen from the blue lounge chairs by the pool.

phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds move over Century City this morning, and a few guests already have the blue lounge chairs by the pool.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass between the sun and the pool, so the twin towers go bright and dull in turn above the cabanas.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the Century City towers look flat and close from the pool, and the cabanas sit mostly empty.
phrases.rain: Rain is rare in Los Angeles, and today it drips from the striped cabanas onto an empty pool deck.
phrases.thunderstorm: Thunder over Century City is unusual, and in the suite living room the French doors stay closed on the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze is common in Los Angeles, and today it softens the twin towers as seen from the California Suite balcony.

phrases.very_cold: On this rare freezing day in Los Angeles, the blue lounge chairs by the pool stay empty under a clear sky.
phrases.very_hot: Very hot today, so guests keep to the striped cabanas and the water while the towers stand in full sun.
phrases.mild_night: Tonight the sky is cloudy, but the air is mild enough for dinner at the candlelit tables on the rooftop terrace.

phrases.rain: Rain falls on the rooftop terrace cushions, so guests watch the wet towers of St. Stephen's from behind the porthole windows.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze over the bay hides the West Bay skyline from the lounge today, though the nearby palm trees and beach are clear.
phrases.snow: Snow almost never reaches Doha, so guests photograph the white flakes over the beach from the suite windows.

phrases.mild_night: A warm cloudy night, with the La Mar beachfront terrace open and the dark sea at eye level from the tables.

phrases.overcast: Under a flat grey sky, the Atlantic looks grey too from the balconies, and the heated indoor pool is the sensible choice.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling windows, and guests watch the wet Atlantic from bed instead of from the balcony.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the Atlantic is visible from the guest rooms, and the teal water of the indoor pool is the calmer option.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, from the suites on level 61, Hyde Park is still dark and the CBD neon is still switched on.

phrases.partly_morning: A few clouds drift over Hyde Park this morning, and swimmers in the level 61 lap pool get the view for free.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the CBD this afternoon, easy to follow from the wrap-around windows of a high-floor suite.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, anyone on the gym treadmills faces a pink and partly cloudy sky over Sydney.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the CBD looks flat and colourless, but from level 70 or so you still see all of it.
phrases.rain: Rain runs down the floor-to-ceiling glass while the hot tub on level 61 stays warm and the harbour turns grey.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over the CBD is best watched from a corner suite living room, with only the glass between you and the storm.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog today means the harbour and eastern suburbs are missing from the corner suite windows, leaving only the nearest CBD towers.
phrases.snow: Snow in Sydney is unheard of, but if it ever fell, the level 61 indoor lap pool would be the viewing spot.
phrases.very_cold: Freezing days are rare in Sydney, and the clear air makes Sydney Tower and the harbour look close from the king rooms.

phrases.mild_night: Tonight is mild and cloudy, and the CBD neon lights the underside of the clouds, seen from a level 75 king room.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the harbor-facing suites look out on a dark, still channel with a clear sky above it.

phrases.rain: Rain streaks the floor-to-ceiling windows of the indoor pool, while swimmers stay warm and the skyline looks blurred.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the Acropolis is a dark outline against a brightening sky from the Deluxe Space Room windows.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky today, the Acropolis shows flat and colourless from the Deluxe Space Room windows.

phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Athens, and the lit Acropolis is still visible from the rooftop lounge seating.

phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the marina, and the indoor pool is the sheltered place to watch the boats getting wet.
phrases.thunderstorm: Lightning over Waitemata Harbour right now is best watched from behind the floor-to-ceiling windows of a suite, not from the terrace.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Cloud shadows move across the greens this afternoon, and guests on the beach loungers get short breaks from the sun.
phrases.partly_golden: Guests on the marina terrace are watching the last sun light up a few clouds behind the Burj Khalifa.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the skyline across Dubai Creek looks flat and pale from the twin-bed rooms with balcony doors open.

phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm the pool and beach are empty, and lightning over the skyline is best seen from inside a room.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hides the Burj Khalifa today, so from the balconies only the near greens and the creek are clear.

phrases.clear_night: If you were on a balcony tonight, you would see stars above the dark outline of Table Mountain.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the poolside loungers watch clouds move across Table Mountain and cover parts of it for minutes at a time.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, the clouds over Lion's Head turn orange when seen from a tiled balcony.
phrases.overcast: Under an overcast sky, the pink façade and the green gardens are the brightest colours in the view.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the empty sun loungers around the outdoor pool, and Table Mountain is partly hidden behind it.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm, guests watch lightning over Table Mountain from inside their rooms rather than from the balconies.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the top of Table Mountain today, so from the terrace only the lower slopes are visible.
phrases.snow: Snow is rare in Cape Town, but today a thin white layer sits on top of Table Mountain, seen from the gardens.
phrases.very_cold: On this very cold day, nobody is swimming in the outdoor pool, though Table Mountain is sharp against a clear sky.
phrases.very_hot: It is very hot in Cape Town, and guests are in the outdoor pool rather than on the loungers facing Table Mountain.
phrases.mild_night: On a mild, cloudy night, the balconies of the Mountain View suites are comfortable, even though Table Mountain is barely visible.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: If you were there this afternoon, you would see the low sun on the cathedral dome from your balcony.
phrases.clear_night: At night the cathedral outline stands over the Spree, which looks like a dark, flat strip of water from the balconies.
phrases.partly_morning: Clouds cross Berlin this morning, so the cathedral dome seen from the balcony changes from bright to shaded often.
phrases.partly_afternoon: Guests on the Collection Premium balconies get sun and shade in turns this afternoon, with the Spree and bridge in view.
phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun comes through gaps in the clouds, lighting the Spree and cathedral in short turns.
phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky, the cathedral's copper dome looks darker than usual from the balcony, and the Spree looks grey too.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the Spree and the stone bridge, and from inside a balcony room the cathedral stays clearly visible.
phrases.thunderstorm: During a thunderstorm the balcony is best left empty, but the cathedral and river can be watched from the bedroom.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog covers the Spree today, so from the balcony the cathedral dome is only a faint outline.
phrases.snow: Snow is falling on the balconies and on the cathedral's copper dome, and the Spree below looks almost black against it.
phrases.very_cold: On a day near freezing, guests step onto the balcony for a short look at the cathedral and then go back in.

phrases.mild_night: A mild cloudy night in Berlin, and from the balcony the cathedral and the dark Spree are both still in view.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the rooftop pool deck is empty and the Downtown LA skyline stands dark against a clear sky.

phrases.clear_midday: At midday the striped loungers by the rooftop pool are in full sun, and the potted cacti need no shade.
phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun turns the Downtown LA skyline orange, and guests on the Cara Cara deck have the clearest view of it.
phrases.clear_night: Tonight the striped fire pit is lit on the rooftop terrace and the Downtown LA high-rises are lit all the way up.

phrases.partly_golden: The last hour of sun turns the clouds pink over the high-rises, seen from the rooftop terrace with its heaters already on.
phrases.overcast: A full cover of cloud sits over Downtown LA today, so the skyline from the rooftop pool looks flat and grey.
phrases.rain: Rain is falling on the rooftop pool deck today, and most guests see the wet skyline from their room windows instead.
phrases.thunderstorm: A thunderstorm has emptied the rooftop pool deck, and the presidential suite's indoor pool is the only sensible place to swim.
phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over Downtown LA today, and from the rooftop deck the farther high-rises look pale and soft-edged.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the sky is clear over Tokyo, and the outline of Mount Fuji is already visible from the 53rd floor.

phrases.partly_afternoon: From the soaking tub by the window, the skyline this afternoon is half in sun and half in cloud shadow.
phrases.partly_golden: In the last hour of sun, scattered clouds are turning orange above the skyline seen from the 53rd floor Club Lounge.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the twin windows of the ocean-view rooms show a dark Atlantic and an empty beach below.
phrases.clear_morning: From the balcony egg chair, the morning sun lights the palm trees, the long pool and the turquoise water.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Clouds pass over South Beach this afternoon, so the two pools get sun one minute and shade the next.

phrases.overcast: A grey sky covers Miami Beach today, and the turquoise water in the room windows looks closer to grey.
phrases.rain: Rain falls on the beach and the palm trees, and guests have moved from the pool to the lobby club chairs.

phrases.fog_haze: Haze hangs over the ocean today, so from the balcony the water is visible but the horizon line is not.

phrases.reduced_visibility: Visibility is low over the water today, so the room windows show the beach and the near ocean but no horizon.

phrases.clear_predawn: Before sunrise, the balconies look onto a dark Robson Square, with only a few lights on in the downtown towers.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast on a terrace suite comes with a clear view of Robson Square and the Vancouver Art Gallery in full daylight.

phrases.clear_golden_pm: Late sun lights the mature trees in Robson Square, and guests on the wrought-iron terrace seats watch it fade.

phrases.rain: Rain is falling on Robson Square, and most guests have moved from the balconies to the eucalyptus steam room or Bacchus Restaurant.

phrases.fog_haze: Fog hides the top floors of the TD and Scotiabank towers, and only the Art Gallery across the square is clear.

phrases.reduced_visibility: The view is shorter today, with Robson Square and the Art Gallery clear but the far downtown towers hard to make out.

phrases.clear_predawn: From the lake-view balconies, Grasmere Lake is dark and still before sunrise, the wooded fells a black outline against clear sky.
phrases.clear_morning: Breakfast tables face a calm Grasmere Lake this morning, with sunlight on the wooded hillside and no cloud anywhere.

phrases.partly_afternoon: Some guests are on the balconies this afternoon, watching cloud shadows cross the wooded hillside on the far side of the lake.

phrases.overcast: Under a grey sky the lake looks flat and grey too, and the indoor hydrotherapy pool is the more popular place.

phrases.thunderstorm: During the storm, guests watch lightning over the fells from inside their lake-view rooms, with the balcony doors closed.
phrases.fog_haze: Fog sits on Grasmere Lake today, so from the balconies you can see the water near the hotel but not the fells.

phrases.very_cold: It is very cold outside, so most guests enjoy the clear view of Grasmere Lake from inside their lake-view rooms.
